verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an official MCP server integration. It connects Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Cowork and any other MCP-compatible client, letting agents query logs, author prompts and scorers, configure Topics and monitoring, and run evals. A probe independently confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the server working in practice, and documented setup, auth and tool-list details in the evidence.
